title: Pixilation — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: One take on the studio floor
scenes.purpose: In pixilation exposures, one performer's idea (a bulb) becomes a system: three more performers slide in without stepping and are cabled together.
visuals: Cool slate studio wall with key-light pool, concrete floor, gaffer-tape pose marks (stationary, seeded grain)
Four performers in the same sage coat and charcoal trousers
Light cream cable with lamp nodes
Headline 'AN IDEA BECOMES / A CONNECTED SYSTEM' in Courier New
Exposure-sheet tick bar and 'POSE nn / 32' readout
Slate caption 'TAKE 07 · SLIDE, NO STEPS · SAME COAT, SAME LIGHT'

beats.development: Poses 1–5: the first performer lifts the bulb in three planned arm poses. The bulb lights on pose 5 and the performer looks up at it.

Poses 6–20: three performers enter from the right one after another, sliding with feet together and leaning into the travel. Each takes a big position jump per exposure, spacing tightens as they near their tape marks, and each recoils for one pose on arrival.

Pose 21: everyone reaches out at once. Poses 22–32: the cable is moved forward one exposure at a time from the bulb, hand to hand. Each lamp node lights as the cable reaches it, ending at the last performer's hand.
Final pose held: the system is complete and the readout shows 'POSE 32 / 32 · FINAL HOLD'. All copy is settled for reading.

findings: Exposure rate is 15 poses/s, separate from the 30 fps delivery rate. Each pose is held 2 frames.
Slide entrances overlap by 4 exposures, so the eye trace runs right to left without dead time.
The headline is static from frame 0, and all motion is settled by 2.07 s, ahead of the 2.7 s requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.067–3.0 s final pose hold: lets the viewer read the completed system and copy.
